50.label: 50 mm · retained learning stages
50.intro: 50 mm is the step height. Four learned components were developed in sequence: earlier policies stayed active with fixed weights while later corrections were trained. These are learning stages, not four increasing obstacle heights.

stages.name: Early motion
stages.goal: Learn forward task progress, then add limited body-posture and obstacle-gap costs.
stages.difficulty: Start naturally at the beginning of the 50 mm task; later stages reuse this learned motion.
stages.progression: Retain the selected early policy and hold its weights fixed during local refinement.
stages.evidence: Saved early policy and training records are verified. No separately verified stage-comparison video is available here.

stages.name: Rear-right transfer
stages.goal: Reward rear-right contact, rear-left transfer and task completion.
stages.difficulty: Learn a local correction after physically reaching its activation interval.
stages.progression: Keep the earlier policy fixed. Rear-right touchdown is an intermediate event, not task completion.
stages.evidence: A retained local policy and stage-specific rewards are documented. No separate stage success rate is claimed.

stages.name: Following transfer
stages.goal: Prepare the front legs, transfer support and continue rear-left lift and placement.
stages.difficulty: Continue beyond rear-right transfer with all 12 correction channels available after activation.
stages.progression: Train the new correction while keeping the complete preceding policy fixed.
stages.evidence: The saved following-transfer component remains in the final controller. Final-policy footage is not a recording of this training stage.

stages.name: Front-left refinement
stages.goal: Encourage forward travel and reduce reverse commands or loaded counter-rotation without progress.
stages.difficulty: Refine one front-left wheel correction during its eligible motion interval.
stages.progression: Update the local policy only in eligible intervals; retain earlier components for the final evaluation.
stages.evidence: Recorded training contains 2,048 decisions and 4 PPO updates. Final completion is evaluated separately.

technical: The final policy computes state-based corrections at 15 Hz; actuator commands and physics run at 120 Hz.
Later local training uses one environment and 512 decisions per rollout. Selected early rollouts use 128 decisions.
Verified PPO settings: clip 0.2, 5 epochs, 4 minibatches, Adam with adaptive learning rate; later discount 0.9985 and GAE 0.99.
Completion objectives also contribute to front-left training. Finish and final-routing records add no selected new learning updates, so they are not counted as additional learned stages.
The final 39-condition evaluation is separate: Recording completed 39/39; the older 50 mm PPO completed 28/39 under the common completion rule.

100.label: 100 mm · latest refinement batches
100.intro: 100 mm is the step height. The latest update keeps the existing joint policy fixed and trains two bounded wheel-compensation gains in four batches. Every batch varies gap and friction within the same task envelope; difficulty does not increase automatically by batch.

stages.name: Batch 1 · establish the update
stages.goal: Improve completion while balancing body tilt, peak inclination and support costs.
stages.difficulty: Eight full simulation episodes spanning the envelope, short gaps with higher friction, longer gaps and nominal conditions.
stages.progression: Finish and verify all episode records before updating and saving the first learned head.
stages.evidence: 8 cumulative episodes; 2 optimizer steps. No separate development screen or stage video at this batch.

stages.name: Batch 2 · check the candidate
stages.goal: Continue learning the same two wheel gains under the completion-first objective.
stages.difficulty: The same four gap/friction strata; eight additional full episodes.
stages.progression: Save the second learned head, then run a separate deterministic development screen.
stages.evidence: 16 cumulative episodes; 4 optimizer steps. The separate 8-case screen recorded 6/8 full successes.

stages.name: Batch 3 · continue refinement
stages.goal: Refine the gains without changing the joint policy, objective or completion rules.
stages.difficulty: Eight more episodes sampled from the same gap/friction distribution.
stages.progression: Verify complete-episode evidence and save the third learned head.
stages.evidence: 24 cumulative episodes; 6 optimizer steps. No separate development screen or stage video at this batch.

stages.name: Batch 4 · freeze for evaluation
stages.goal: Complete the planned refinement and select a candidate for independent evaluation.
stages.difficulty: The final eight episodes use the same varied task envelope.
stages.progression: Require nominal full success, prioritize development completion, then freeze the selected weights before held-out evaluation.
stages.evidence: 32 cumulative episodes; 9 optimizer steps. Separate development screen: 7/8 full successes. The displayed final videos use this selected head.

technical: Only a two-dimensional episode-level Gaussian PPO wheel-gain head learns in this update. The inherited joint policy remains fixed; this is not whole-network retraining.
The 32 complete episodes form 16 paired scenario/noise draws. Each batch cycles the same four scenario strata, rather than an easy-to-hard curriculum.
Verified head settings: clip 0.2, learning rate 0.08, up to 5 epochs with target KL 0.025. This head uses complete-episode returns, without a critic or GAE.
Selection requires nominal common-and-native success, then prioritizes completion and fewer collision aborts. Held-out conditions are not used for selection.
Development screens, the 39-condition regression, the 8 held-out conditions and demonstration videos are separate from training episodes.
The complete-controller comparison includes previously established motion and control components; it does not isolate PPO learning as the sole cause of the difference.
